# PR — 264_R6FIX.14 · analytics self-traffic tagging + funnel re-baseline

**Branch:** `stevevitali/r6fix-14-analytics` · **Base:** `main` · **mergePolicy:** OPERATOR — this run does not merge.

## What

Automated traffic (journeys suite, smoke legs, agent probes) now carries a stable marker —
the ` +RhemaJourney` user-agent token (`AUTOMATED_TRAFFIC_UA_MARKER`, `@rhema/contracts`) —
stamped at ONE seam: `packages/journeys/src/marked-context.ts` `newMarkedContext`, which every
production `browser.newContext` call site in the journeys package now rides (runner anon,
session open/mint, steps ×3, r7legs ×2, demo-side-effects, hero-capture, speed-leg). Legs
passing their own `userAgent` (the `IPHONE_USER_AGENT` phone legs) get the marker appended —
`isPhoneRequest`'s `/Mobi/` read is undisturbed. No leg needed per-leg changes; AGENTS.md now
bans direct `newContext` calls.

The marker classifies into `acquisition_events.surface` (the column migration 0037 shipped but
nothing wrote): the **web relay** (`landingBeacon`, covering `GET /` + `POST /a/landing`) forwards
its inbound-UA verdict, and the **api ingest** (`POST /analytics/landing`) treats `web:auto` as
additive — either channel marking wins, a `web` value or forged field can never un-mark, absent
fields fall back to the api's own UA read (a marked direct probe still lands `web:auto`).
Exclusion is `WHERE surface <> 'web:auto'` at the query layer — **no stored-history rewrite**.

**UA suffix over a marker header** (recorded in the run ledger): `navigator.sendBeacon` can't
attach headers — a header marker would die on the drop-zone hop; and the committed SPA.28 pin
(`extraHTTPHeaders`-free contexts) survives verbatim — now scanning every context call.
